texts.preamble: Swapna Roy W/O Subrata Roy Sahara vs State Of Gujarat & 3 on 6 October, 2015 Author: J.B.Pardiwala Bench: J.B.Pardiwala R/Scr.A/5711/2015 O In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad Special Criminal Application (Quashing) No. 5711 of 2015 ========================================================== Swapna Roy W/O Subrata Roy SAHARA....Applicant(s) Versus State Of Gujarat & 3....Respondent(s) ========================================================== Appearance: Mr. Percy Kavina, Sr. Counsel with Mr Bhash H Mankad, Ms. Garima Malhotra And Ms. Neha Gupta, Advocates for the Applicant(s) No. 1 Public Prosecutor for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ========================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr.Justice J.B.Pardiwala Date : 06/10/2015 Oral Order
texts.arguments: The principal argument of Mr. Kavina, the learned Senior Advocate appearing for the applicant - original accused No.4 is that although the applicant was a Director at a point of time in the company alleged to have committed the offence under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, yet had resigned as a Director of the company on 16.7.2012. He invited my attention to Section 66 of the Act, 2006, which creates a vicarious liability of the person who, at the time of the offence, is said to be in charge of, and responsible to the company for the conduct of the business of the company. Mr. Kavina read over the entire complaint and prima-facie it appears that there is not a single averment in the complaint lodged by the Food Safety Officer of the Junagadh Municipal Corporation, that the applicant herein is the Director of the company and is responsible for the day-to-day affairs and management of the same. 1 Mr. Kavina further submitted that without any proper verification in this regard, the learned Magistrate proceeded to take cognizance upon the complaint and HC-NIC Page 1 of 2 Created On Fri Oct 09 00:55:53 IST 2015 R/SCR.A/5711/2015 ORDER issued process. The learned senior counsel has placed reliance on the following decisions of the Supreme Court:- 1. Harshendrakumar Vs. Rebatila Koley, reported in (2011) 3 SCC 351; 2. Gunmala Sales Pvt.Ltd. Vs. Anu Mehta, reported in (2015) 1 SCC 103.
